source_title: Pattern of Driver-Like Input onto Neurons of the Mouse Ventral Lateral Geniculate Nucleus
section: Optogenetic activation of corticothalamic layer V terminals in vLGNi
node_relevance_reason: Directly tests vLGNi neurons: devoid of retinal input but receive layer V corticothalamic driver-like excitation.
summary: In slice optogenetics, vLGNi neurons showed no retinally evoked activity but 10 of 21 responded to corticothalamic layer V terminal stimulation with depressing EPSCs. vLGNi transcriptome resembles adjacent caudal prethalamic inhibitory regions such as zona incerta; it receives layer V input but no retinal input, and its efferent targets are unresolved.
quotes: To examine the synaptic responses associated with corticothalamic input to vLGNi
We also made AAV eye injections of ChrimsonR-tdTomato in these mice to verify that vLGNi neurons are devoid of retinal input
blue light stimulation of corticothalamic terminals led to excitatory postsynaptic activity in 10 of 21 neurons tested (Fig. 6A)

Together, these data suggest that the transcriptome and cellular organization of vLGNi are more closely aligned with other, adjacent regions of the caudal prethalamus, such as zona incerta, than with vLGNe
Other anatomic studies suggest differences in brainstem cholinergic inputs, which are dense in vLGNe but sparse in vLGNi

source_title: Diverse GABAergic neurons organize into subtype-specific sublaminae in the ventral lateral geniculate nucleus
section: | Do laminated retinorecipient circuits organize visual pathways through the vLGN?
node_relevance_reason: Sabbagh et al. report GABAergic types in non-retinorecipient vLGNi; no retinorecipient cells found there by anterograde tracing.
summary: Anterograde trans-synaptic tracing found retinorecipient Ecel1, Pvalb, Spp1 and Penk cells only in vLGNe sublaminae, none in vLGNi.
quotes: While we failed to observe any retinorecipient cells in vLGNi using this method, it certainly remains possible that the dendrites of cells in vLGNi extend into vLGNe and receive monosynaptic input from the retina.

source_title: Retinal Input Is Required for the Maintenance of Neuronal Laminae in the Ventrolateral Geniculate Nucleus
section: Development of the external and internal divisions of vLGN
node_relevance_reason: Defines vLGNi as the nonretinorecipient internal division and gives its developmental area proportions, noting GABAergic types occupy it.
summary: vLGN has retinorecipient vLGNe and nonretinorecipient vLGNi; vLGNi occupies 40% of vLGN at P1 falling to 28% after P21.
quotes: The rodent vLGN can be divided into two distinct domains based on cytoarchitecture: the retinorecipient external division (vLGNe) and the nonretinorecipient internal division (vLGNi).
At P1, the proportions of the area occupied by vLGNe and vLGNi were 60 and 40%, respectively.

source_title: A Role for Thalamic Projection GABAergic Neurons in Circadian Responses to Light
node_relevance_reason: Sox14 marks thalamic GABAergic projection neurons in IGL/LGv; consistent with Sox14 marker but not specific to vLGNi.
summary: Thalamic GABAergic projection neurons are defined by Sox14 and populate IGL and LGv; Sox14+ IGL/LGv neurons reset circadian rhythms.
quotes: can be defined by expression of the transcription factor gene Sox14
Hence, the mature IGL and LGv are characterized by a heterogenous cellular composition that includes Sox14 1 GABAergic thalamic neurons.
